added_lines: telephone: 01 - 4522251 the waking by theodore roethke (1908 –1963) i wake to sleep, and take my waking slow. i feel my fate in what i cannot fear. i learn by going where i have to go. we think by feeling. what is there to know? i hear my being dance from ear to ear. i wake to sleep, and take my waking slow. of those so close beside me, which are you? god bless the ground! i shall walk softly there, and learn by going where i have to go. light takes the tree; but who can tell us how? the lowly worm climbs up a winding stair; i wake to sleep, and take my waking slow. great nature has another thing to do to you and me; so take the lively air, and, lovely, learn by going where to go. this shaking keeps me steady. i should know. what falls away is always. and is near. i wake to sleep, and take my waking slow. i learn by going where i have to go. ———————— - we would like to send our condolences to the family and friends of the late martina cullen beloved mammy to chloe and jessica whose funeral took place on thursday october 22nd may she rest in peace —————— please take this home with you as you leave killinard en parish sacred heart chur ch thought of the day you are in charge of your mindset: choose to look for the bright side, even when things feel busy or slow. ———— - ce vancanies killinarden parish currently have com- munity employment vacancies for: security guards/office admin criteria for these positions: you must be 21 years or over and be in receipt of a social welfare payment for a minimum of 12 months. if you are interested in working in your local community or want further information contact: mary 01-4621973 or call into arás croí nua ————————————— parish lotto the lotto was not won on the 21st october the numbers were 4, 19, 23 the next lotto is on the 28th october and the jackpot will be €1,700. killinarden
